label: Trails of Blood & Dust Test
notes: Rules Lab test configuration. Nothing here is published: the creator's sheet and roller never read it. Setting experiments listed under 'experiments' can be switched on in the GM tab's Encounter panel. Weapon traits are added in the lab (or here) as { type: 'accuracy', value, bands: ['close'], requires: { aimed, ammo, mode }, label }; none are set until their values are decided. Grievous wounds: the table and the opponents' descriptions are under 'grievous'.

table.name: Lost limb
table.text: A hand, an arm or a leg is gone; the GM says which. −4 to tasks that need it, or impossible. Dying unless someone stops the bleeding.

table.name: Lost eye
table.text: −2 to Shooting and to spotting things, for good.

table.name: Broken bone
table.text: The limb is useless until proper care, and heals over weeks.

table.name: Torn muscle
table.text: −1 to physical tasks until a week of proper care.

table.name: Concussion
table.text: Dazed, and −2 to thinking tasks for the scene.

table.name: Internal injury
table.text: Dying even with boxes to spare; it needs a surgeon.

gun: The shot shatters {name}'s knee; they won't stand again today.
{name} takes it in the gut and sits down hard in the street.
A round through the shoulder spins {name} into the dirt, gun gone.
{name} goes back through the batwing doors and lies still.
blade: The blade takes {name}'s gun hand off at the wrist.
{name} folds around the blade and doesn't get up.
A cut across the face blinds {name}, who stumbles off screaming.
claw: Claws open {name} from collarbone to hip.
{name} is dragged down, screaming, and goes quiet.
blunt: {name}'s jaw breaks with a crack heard across the room.
missile: An arrow pins {name}'s thigh to the boards.
{name} catches it in the throat and goes down choking.
